rows.text: The Reserve Bank today reduced the Official Cash Rate (OCR) by 50 basis points to 2.5 percent.
The Reserve Bank today reduced the Official Cash Rate (OCR) by 50 basis points to 2.5 percent.
Reserve Bank Governor Alan Bollard said: "The Reserve Bank extends its sympathies to all those affected by the Christchurch earthquake.
